scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
( 
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
                ,FILE_NAME
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
(
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CC.CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CC.CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CC.CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CC.CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT B
            ON CC.CAT_CRD_ID  = B.CAT_CRD_ID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC
(
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CAT_CRD_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CAT_CRD_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT
(
                 CAT_CRD_ID
                ,CAT_ACN_ID
                ,CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE 
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST 
				,BNK_CODE 
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                 SRC.CAT_CRD_ID
                ,SRC.CAT_ACN_ID
                ,SRC.CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
                ,SRC.CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
                ,SRC.CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
				,SRC.FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME, 5)
				,'ATM'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_ATM_CARDACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
